svg.title: Тибиалис-подъём с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated resistance-band dorsiflexion. Fully clothed adult seated on floor, trunk upright, working leg extended in front with heel resting on floor. Opposite knee bent. A taut elastic band runs from a visible low fixed anchor beyond the working foot directly to a LOOP encircling the ball of the working foot. START foot points gently toward anchor. END toes visibly pull up and back toward shin, against pull of band, same heel stays down. Clear side view. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
